name: Designing Efficient Facilities in Challenging Locations (JPT)
subtopics: Minimum facility platform layout: lower-deck equipment, well slots, power autonomy, visit interval
publisher_org: Society of Petroleum Engineers (Journal of Petroleum Technology)
notes: Three facility cases; the third is a PTTEP minimum facility platform (MFP) in the Arthit field, Gulf of Thailand: 262.5 ft water depth, 9-15 well slots versus 16 conventional, lower deck carrying a booster compressor, test separator, manifolds, wellhead control panel, pig launcher, provisional pig receiver and SCADA, a mobile pig launcher for subsea pigging, solar power with battery back-up (96 h process control, 192 h safety), an 8-in condensate line to a floating storage unit and a 42-in gas export line, unmanned with visits no more than every 4 weeks, and an estimated 20% deck-area and up to 30% cost reduction. Page read 2026-11-27.
